scope: Channel-native, source-grounded sibling writing requests and protected candidate acceptance

red_evidence.reason: the native-writing production module was absent

acceptance_cases.R10: WeChat article, Xiaohongshu note, and Douyin script resolve to distinct structures, recipes, and output contracts
acceptance_cases.R24: private author facts and source anecdotes are absent from vendor requests and rejected in candidate text
acceptance_cases.R25: unsupported fixed engagement multiplier claims are absent from vendor requests and rejected in candidate text
acceptance_cases.R26: the existing protected-fact engine blocks changed commands, numbers, units, negation, URLs, and other deterministic facts

assertions: all three channel variants descend independently from one source bundle and one sibling group
no channel variant derives from another channel's final text
every selected claim must have a final-text rendering
protected terminology and deterministic facts cannot be silently changed
accepted output remains review-required with fresh detection and approval required
the authoring boundary is candidate-only and cannot perform remote delivery

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy
